Best of Tests DS.name: Best of Tests DS
Best of Tests DS.summary:
THINK THEREFORE I PLAY! 
 
Logic, observation, memory, speed of perception and analysis: these are the qualities that defi ne the famous Intelligence Quotient and the ones that Best of Tests DS will enable you to test, according to renown scientifi c protocols. It will also allow you to improve them! 
 
Through the very many tests and using all the functionalities specifi c to the Nintendo DS which are found in the three gaming modes (Training – verbal, numbers and letters, drawings, playing cards, dominos, etc. - Memory and Tests) 
Best of Tests DS calculates your I.Q. and adapts itself to your level in order to offer you a personalized challenge that is always renewed and updated. 
All the classic challenges of I.Q. tests on your Nintendo DS. 
An excellent way to maintain and improve your intelligence, while you are having fun! 
Several hundred different questions 
The best way to prepare for professional I.Q. tests! 
A continually renewed interest thanks to the varied rules and different ways to answers the questions. 
An incremental diffi culty level with tests that are increasingly more diffi cult! 
Serious results, presented in a humorous manner.

Diary Girl.name: Diary Girl
Diary Girl.summary: An electronic diary for your DS, with mini games, quizzes, chat, and you can also play dress-up.

Kaijuu Busters Powered.name: Kaijuu Busters Powered
Kaijuu Busters Powered.summary: A Bandai Namco developed kaijuu based action game released exclusively on the Nintendo DS

Maestro! - Jump in Music.name: Maestro! Jump in Music
Maestro! - Jump in Music.summary: Discover Presto, the music-loving bird, and make him evolve in a colorful, decibel-filled journey. Use the stylus to scrape, rub, tap and whirl to the rhythm of the level's music and like a good Maestro, stick to the original. Presto will jump or get off a platform in the order in which you strum the string, flying with his small wings to reach the music score.

Mizuiro Blood.name: Mizuiro Blood
Mizuiro Blood.summary: A collection of mini-games themed around a school-faring robot, Mizuiro-chan, and her school days at Blood Academy. The game uses the Nintendo DS stylus to draw and write within the game.

Need for Speed - Nitro.name: Need for Speed: Nitro
Need for Speed - Nitro.summary:
Unleash your inner speed demon with Need for Speed Nitro for the Nintendo DS. This high-energy racing game delivers fast-paced, arcade-style action, letting you dominate the streets with style and speed.

Choose from a wide selection of licensed cars from top manufacturers and customize them with an array of performance upgrades and visual modifications to create your ultimate racing machine. Race through vibrant and dynamic environments inspired by real-world locations, each filled with shortcuts and hidden paths that provide strategic advantages.

Take on challenging AI opponents in various game modes, including Circuit, Elimination, and Drift. Master the art of drifting and nitro boosts to leave your rivals in the dust and achieve victory. The intuitive controls and responsive touch screen interface make car handling smooth and enjoyable.

Compete with friends in local multiplayer races via DS Download Play, and show off your racing skills and custom rides. With its colorful graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and exhilarating gameplay, Need for Speed Nitro for the Nintendo DS offers a thrilling racing experience that you can take anywhere.

Get ready to rev your engines and burn rubber in a race to the finish line. Speed, style, and adrenaline await you in Need for Speed Nitro!

Puzzle de Harvest Moon.name: Puzzle de Harvest Moon
Puzzle de Harvest Moon.summary: A puzzle game based on the Harvest Moon series.

Shaun the Sheep.name: Shaun the Sheep
Shaun the Sheep.summary: Adventure game based on the kids TV show.

Sudoku Gridmaster.name: Sudoku Gridmaster
Sudoku Gridmaster.summary: SuDoku Master is a Puzzle game, developed by Greenstreet Games and published by eGames, which was released in 2005.

Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou - Dai-4-sh.name: Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou Dai-4-Shuu: Time Machine no Nazotoki Daibouken
Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou - Dai-4-sh.summary: Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou Dai-4-Shuu: Time Machine no Nazotoki Daibouken is an puzzle game, developed and published by Level 5, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Transformers Prime.name: Transformers Prime: The Game
Transformers Prime.summary: Transformers: Prime lets fans play as their favorite Autobot characters and embark on an action-packed adventure to save the earth from the evil Megatron and his new secret weapon.

Where's Waldo - The Fantastic Journey.name: Where's Waldo? The Fantastic Journey
Where's Waldo - The Fantastic Journey.summary:
Join the search for Waldo, his friends and more!

Based on the hit publishing series, Where's Waldo?: The Fantastic Journey is the ultimate search and find adventure for the whole family! Search and Find: Twelve fantastic worlds of oddities and adventure.
